newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells plans bonus share issue.
newsitem.headline: John Keells plans bonus share issue.

text.p: John Keells Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned a bonus issue of one new share for every seven held.

"Since the group has not done too badly under trying conditions in the first six months of 1996, and we had the reserves, we felt shareholders needed to be rewarded," JKH chairman Ken Balendra told Reuters.
The company made a net profit of 129.09 milion rupees in the six months ended September 30, 1996, compared with 126.71 million in the same period in 1995.
